styleHints.COMBO: Chains plays to set a board in one turn.
styleHints.MIDRANGE: Plays its game without betting everything on one turn.
styleHints.CONTROL: Lets the opponent come, and answers.
styleHints.STUN: Locks the game down rather than answering it.

reasons.HAND_TRAPS: Enough hand traps to stop them on their turn.
reasons.NO_HAND_TRAPS: Too few hand traps: they play their turn untouched.
reasons.BREAKERS: Enough mass removal to clear what they set up.
reasons.NO_BREAKERS: Nothing to clear an established board.
reasons.LOCK: Your floodgates shut their plan down.
reasons.FRAGILE_SETUP: Your plan needs a board, and theirs stops you building one.
reasons.DISRUPTION: Enough interaction to answer them in time.
reasons.RESILIENCE: You come back from what they take away.
